Job Description

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer with deep Python proficiency and AWS expertise to build, deploy, and scale AI/ML solutions. You will leverage services like Bedrock for generative AI workflows, collaborating across teams to deliver production - ready mod els that solve real business challenges.

Responsibilities
Design and develop ML models using Python libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit - learn) for tasks like predictive analytics, NLP, and computer vision.
Build end - to - end pipelines on AWS, including data ingestion (S3/Glue), training (SageMaker), deployment (Lambda/EC2), and generative AI via Bedrock for custom agents, fine - tuning, and RAG applications.
Integrate Bedrock with other AWS services (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway) to create scalable, secure APIs for foundation models like Anthropic Claude or Stability AI.
Optimize models for performance, cost, and reliability; implement monitoring (CloudWatch) and CI/CD for MLOps.
Experiment with prompt engineering, model evaluation, and hybrid solutions combining custom ML with Bedrocks managed capabilities.
Required Qualifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field.
4+ years in AI/ML engineering, with advanced Python skills for data pipelines, APIs, and ML workflows.
Hands - on AWS experience: SageMaker, S3, Lambda, EC2, and specifically Bedrock for generative AI development and deployment.
Strong ML fundamentals: feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation metrics, and deployment best practices.
Proficiency in SQL/NoSQL, Git, and containerization (Docker)

Preferred Skills

AWS certifications (e.g., Machine Learning Specialty, Bedrock - focused training).
Experience with LLMs, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone via Bedrock), and RAG architectures.
Knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS) and Terraform for infrastructure as code

Integrate solutions with existing systems and applications. Responsible for MLOps and DevOps to ensure scalability, reliability, and security of these systems
Implement automation tools and processes for Agent flows, RPA, GenAI, model training, testing, and deployment
Build tools and capabilities for model management and model performance monitoring
Collaborate effectively with the team and across cross-functional stakeholders
Model a high-performance culture with critical thinking, problem-solving, learning, collaboration, and experimentation within the team

Bachelor's degree completed in Computer Science, AI or a related field
3+ years of experience with AI, software engineering, MLOps, DevOps, or data engineering, in a professional role
Experience with document intelligence, generative AI, agentic AI, automation, NLP and machine learning

Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management tools such as Jira.
